name: Elf

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Same rule as the Dwarf's: one band brighter for your own rolls (Detection, aim, scouting share, the ambush roll when you are the party's best Perception); loot at the true band.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: +2 Detection (applies to the party's best Detection when the Elf holds it); scouting chance +5% (stacks with the Ranger's +5%).

traits.name: Lightfoot
traits.description: +5 base Speed; Web and Root durations on you are one turn shorter (minimum 1).

traits.name: Slight Frame
traits.description: Max HP ×0.90; the Plate and Mail Speed penalties are doubled (−40 / −20); Fear resistance −10 points.

creationBlurb: From the gloam-woods. Fastest on the timeline and first to notice anything.
